title: Don't Drop the Singletons: Efficient Inference for Pairwise Experiments with Independent Attrition
abstract: arXiv:2608.18973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pairwise randomization can yield substantial efficiency gains in experiments. Yet methodological guidance cautions against pairwise randomization, especially in settings with attrition, partly because common practices for estimation (i.e., pair fixed effects) imply discarding data from incomplete pairs thus exacerbating data loss from attrition. This practice of dropping incomplete pairs reduces statistical power of tests as well as precision of estimates, in paired experiments, compared to designs with less finely stratified treatment assignment. We argue that this concern is misplaced if attrition is independent of treatment status and potential outcomes, and that these issues follow from an inefficient use of the data that remains post-attrition. translated_title: 不要丢弃单例：配对实验中存在独立流失情况下的高效推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18973v1 公告类型：新 摘要：配对随机化在实验中可以带来显著的效率提升。然而，方法论指导建议谨慎使用配对随机化，特别是在存在流失的情况下，部分原因是常见的估计方法（即配对固定效应）意味着丢弃不完整配对的数据，从而加剧了流失造成的数据损失。与分层较少的处理分配设计相比，在配对实验中，丢弃不完整配对的做法会降低检验的统计功效以及估计的精度。我们认为，如果流失独立于处理状态和潜在结果，这种担忧是多余的，这些问题源于对流失后剩余数据的低效使用。首先，我们展示了通过使用特定的置换检验，可以利用所有观察到的单元进行推断（包括完整配对和只有一个单元流失的不完整配对），同时仍然利用配对设计带来的效率优势。
tldr: 本文提出在配对实验存在独立流失时，通过特定置换检验可充分利用所有观测数据（包括不完整配对），避免丢弃数据导致的效率损失，从而纠正传统方法对配对随机化的担忧。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in paired experiments with independent attrition, a specific permutation test can utilize all observed units (including incomplete pairs), avoiding efficiency loss from data discarding and correcting traditional concerns about pairwise randomization.
